data.title: Advanced Ratio Reasoning: Unit Rates in Real-World Contexts
data.description: Explore equivalent ratios and calculate unit rates across various real-world scenarios including recipes, commercial pricing, velocity, and chemical solutions to develop critical proportional reasoning.

challenges.instruction: If 4 cups of organic flour produce 52 artisanal crackers, determine the unit rate of crackers per single cup of flour.
challenges.hint: Divide the total number of crackers by the number of cups of flour to find the yield for exactly 1 cup.

challenges.instruction: A bulk supplier sells 15 kilograms of specialty coffee beans for $225. Calculate the unit price per kilogram.
challenges.hint: Divide the total cost by the number of kilograms to establish the cost per single kilogram.

challenges.instruction: A high-speed train travels 350 miles in 3.5 hours. Determine the average speed in miles per hour as your unit rate.
challenges.hint: Divide the total distance by the total hours to find how many miles are covered in 1 hour.

challenges.instruction: In a laboratory chemical mixture, 12 milliliters of solute are dissolved in 80 milliliters of solvent. Find the unit rate of solute per 1 milliliter of solvent.
challenges.hint: Divide the amount of solute by the amount of solvent to determine the fractional ratio per 1 mL of solvent.
